children: Minesto resolved on a rights issue of up to SEK 130M at SEK 0.30 per share, with expected net proceeds of approximately SEK 115M after estimated SEK 15M costs. Commitments and guarantees cover SEK 78M, or approximately 60%; full subscription would dilute non-participating shareholders by up to approximately 62.5%.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Up to SEK 130M gross; SEK 115M net expected
The raise addresses insufficient working capital; net proceeds are reduced by estimated SEK 15M in issue costs.
SEK 0.30/share, approx. 30% discount to TERP
The discounted price supports subscription but may pressure the market price and signals substantial dilution.
Commitments and guarantee cover SEK 78M, approx. 60%
At least 40% of the issue remains uncovered; commitments are not secured by bank guarantees or similar arrangements.
Full issue adds 433.5M shares; up to 62.5% dilution
Non-participants face substantial ownership dilution, though they can sell subscription rights to compensate financially.
Guarantee warrants could add 5% dilution
Vator will receive 36.5M warrants free of charge, exercisable at SEK 0.42 per share for five years.
Subscription period: Dec. 7–21, 2026
Shareholders must act within the subscription window; unused rights expire and lose their value.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a financing step for Minesto's commercial and technology plans, following operational demonstrations and planned commercial projects. Progress depends on subscriptions, completion of the raise and deployment of the proceeds toward those plans.
